text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It looks like you scored very well on the 
recent test, Alve. Well done. ...As for 
Ruler, on the other hand...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You're late for the test. ...Honestly. 
When are you ever going to break that 
habit of going back to sleep?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Gah! There's a reason for this—!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
There is no excuse for going back to 
sleep. Besides, more so than the act 
itself, I am warning you about your 
failure to take preventive measures.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Alv. You're in the same class as Ruler, 
right? If possible, could you look out for 
her from time to time?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Getting involved with someone... would 
just be a hassle, so.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Cruel. That's just too cruel... Calling me 
troublesome. You said I'm 
troublesomeee...!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Huh? No, I didn't mean it like—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
You called me troublesomeee~~~!! Dammit, 
dammit! When it comes to being mentally 
troublesome, you're hardly any different 
yourself...!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. What is that supposed to 
mean...?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, that is quite enough!! Honestly, 
the lot of you...!!
